algorithm.convergence_criteria: PageRank/eigenvector calculations are described mathematically, but no reproducible stopping rule or numerical trace is supplied.
software: The source names PageRank, AHP/YAAHP, and data websites, but code, graph files, query snapshots, and solver settings are absent.

assumptions: Keep population, relation direction, edge weight, cooperation threshold, AHP ordering, time window, and feedback ratio explicit.
Keep a network score, a displayed rank, a proxy input, and a causal or operational claim distinct.
models.computational_cost: The source identifies network and eigenvector calculations but reports no runtime, memory, data-collection, or decision cost.

details: Researchers, papers, and actors are separate populations; the 511/15/31 sample boundaries remain part of interpretation.
The eigenvector/PageRank computation omits an iteration trace, convergence criterion, and dangling-node policy.
The source fixes a piecewise cooperation term, AHP priorities, and equal citation feedback, but does not freeze calibration or data snapshots.
No graph, factor, query, ranking, perturbation, or application uncertainty is propagated.

constraints: Preserve node identity, graph direction, metric direction, normalization, threshold, selected perturbation, and time window at every handoff.
Do not promote rank overlap, rank movement, or local visual stability to external validation without an independent outcome.

equation_status.reason: All numbered source equations assigned to this unit are retained in source order and visually checked.

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: Formula structures are inspectable, but full graphs, inclusion lists, dates, query provenance, solver trace, and validation outcomes are not released.

limitations: The displayed interval is local and lacks score, full-rank, and uncertainty checks.
missing_details: Raw graph files, inclusion/exclusion lists, data dates, threshold calibration, matrix convention, convergence trace, AHP provenance, actor selection, uncertainty, and external outcome validation.

parameter_estimation.method: The source constructs graphs, asserts a piecewise threshold, sets AHP comparisons, and varies deletion/feedback parameters without fitting them to an outcome.

strengths: The source exposes a counterexample, a method switch, a paper-factor handoff, a transfer exception, and two sensitivity mechanisms.
